title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Getting Started and Eligibility Requirements
summary: This document explains eligibility and onboarding for the Business Silver Rewards Card, including minimum $700 personal FICO (or Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX 47+), typical approved credit limits ($17,500–$112,500), and pricing (annual fee $122.50; new-customer first-year promo fee 0; APR 18.99%). It also lists application steps and what to prepare (legal/business details, employer identifiers, ownership structure, estimated annual revenue) and tips to strengthen approval.
faqs: What are the minimum eligibility requirements for the Business Silver Rewards Card (personal FICO and/or Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX)?
What approved credit limits can I generally expect with the Business Silver Rewards Card?
What annual fee and APR should I expect after approval (including the first-year promo)?
What information do I need to prepare to apply for the Business Silver Rewards Card?
Do I need to authorize a personal credit pull or provide business credit information?
After approval, what steps are involved to set up account access and authorized users?
keywords: Business information to prepare (legal name/address/formation/employer identifiers/ownership/estimated annual revenue)
